# The Lighthouse: characters

## Maren Hale

The keeper's daughter, nineteen. Knows the light better than her father did by the end. Stays on
the Point after the inquiry, though nothing obliges her to. The book is hers.

## Tobias Hale

Her brother, twenty-three. A good mechanic who would rather be at sea. Worked on the new clockwork
before he left with the fleet. The question the book turns on: did he know it would fail?

## Elias Hale

The keeper. Proud, careful, behind the times. Distrusted the new clockwork and said so in his
logbook.

## The harbour board

Three men on the mainland who need the failure to be the keeper's fault, because the clockwork was
their purchase.
